units.source_text: 这在河童国是再正常不过的事情啦。

en.t: That is the most ordinary thing in the land of the kappa.

units.source_text: 原本绘画啦，文艺什么的……”

en.t: After all, painting, literature, and things like that...

units.source_text: 每当有什么东西飞过来时，马咯就缩一缩脖子，

en.t: Whenever something came flying at him, Mag drew in his neck,

units.source_text: 接着依然冷静地往下说，

en.t: and then calmly went on speaking.

units.source_text: “绘画啦，文艺什么的，到底要表达什么，

en.t: Painting, literature, and such things, whatever they are trying to express,
everyone can understand them by looking.

units.source_text: 因此，这个国家尽管并不禁止书籍发行或者绘画展览，

en.t: Therefore, although this country does not forbid the publication of books or the exhibition of paintings,
it does forbid performances of music.

units.source_text: 因为只有音乐，无论是怎么有伤风化的曲子，

en.t: Because music alone, no matter how indecent the tune may be,

units.source_text: 对于没有耳朵的河童来说都是听不懂得。”

en.t: cannot be understood at all by kappa, who have no ears.
